Frequently asked questions

What glass installation work do you do?

We fit glass windows, aluminium windows and doors, office partitions, and handle glass replacement and custom work.

How do I request a quotation?

Send the contact form, message us on WhatsApp or call. Share the service you need, your location and a short description. Photos and measurements help.

Which areas do you serve?

We are based in Ngong and serve nearby areas. Contact us to confirm whether we can reach your location.

How long will my project take?

It depends on the size and type of work and the materials needed. We confirm a timeline when we give your quotation.

What glass options are available?

Options can include clear, tinted, frosted and tempered glass, with different frame finishes. Tell us what you need and we will advise on what suits your project.
